content.short: Brale is a regulated platform for stablecoin issuance, custody, payments and compliance.
content.description: Brale runs stablecoin issuance as a regulated service, holding money transmitter licences across most US jurisdictions so that issuers do not have to obtain them individually. Licensing is the genuine barrier in this business, and it is why issuance-as-a-service exists as a category at all.
content.meta: Stablecoin issuance as a licensed service, covering custody, payments and US regulatory coverage.
